failure_signature: Run 621: Narrowness/Candidate Gate bounded rewrite recovery exhausted 57/60 API calls with no passing Winner
symptoms: both bounded-recovery mechanisms (Narrowness self-critique recovery in content/candidate_explorer.py, Candidate Gate recovery in content/candidate_gate.py) worked exactly as designed -- bounded, no forced-pass -- but did not help
candidates rejected as 'too broad' were rewritten and rechecked, but the rewrites themselves kept coming back broad/generic, exhausting both 2-cycle bounds repeatedly
API calls climbed to 57/60 without ever producing a passing Winner, i.e. the run was heading toward hard budget exhaustion rather than a clean REGENERATE/failure

root_cause.summary: The rewrite prompts for both recovery loops told the model to 'be more specific' without naming a concrete axis to narrow along, and did not penalize a Reveal that stopped at a bare generic-purpose word (efficiency/safety/optimization). The model's rewrites therefore tended to stay generic, so the same bounded-but-repeated rewrite cycle kept firing across many candidates in one run, consuming the shared API budget even though no single loop exceeded its own 2-attempt cap.

evidence.note: PR body and the added regression test's own docstring both independently cite 'Run 621 (job 35401815431, commit 11c151f)' and the 57/60 call figure -- two independent GitHub-native artifacts agreeing. NOTE: the PR's own text labels 35401815431 as a 'job' id, but its magnitude matches this repository's GitHub Actions RUN id range (e.g. 35580671177, 35414363774), not its job id range (e.g. 106272556899) -- recorded here as run_id, not job_id, on that basis. Neither the PR's own label nor this correction was independently re-opened against the live GitHub Actions run in this session; treat as PARTIAL, not re-verified raw evidence.
added by this PR; its module docstring restates the same run/job/commit citation as the PR body.
fix commit message restates the same root cause in the same terms.

fix.summary: Added a semantic 4-element generation contract (concrete subject / observable phenomenon / specific question / specific reveal) with few-shot examples to the Explorer's prompt; strengthened both rewrite prompts to require narrowing along one named concrete axis (part/location/condition/number/exception/before-after/shape) and to instruct against stopping at a bare generic-purpose word; added has_budget_for_rewrite() as a small safety-reserve check so a rewrite cycle is skipped (discarding the candidate, same as hitting the existing 2-rewrite cap) once the API budget reserve is low, instead of risking mid-call exhaustion; added a conservative deterministic pre-check that skips the LLM Narrowness self-critique call only for a bare 'why is X efficient/safe/optimized' pattern. No gate threshold changed, no recovery-call bound increased, V3_MAX_API_CALLS/V3_MAX_COST_USD unchanged.

relationships.note: This PR's own diff also independently fixed overlapping stale MAX_TOPIC_REGENERATIONS assertions in CI workflow files, unrelated to its main budget/prompt fix.
